key_responsibilities: Provide an HTTP request handler class (H) to serve the desktop UI and respond to web requests.
Manage persistent data in a filesystem-based zi_data directory with read_json, write_json, make_job, and list_jobs utilities.
Scan and import audio files from a library (scan_library and import_folder) using configured audio extensions.
Create simple cover images (make_cover) and produce packaged release exports (export_release), potentially invoking external tools.
Expose a command-line entry point (main) to start the app and open the UI in a browser.
notable_patterns: Subclass of http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler to implement web UI interactions.
File-system centric data management: JSON files and directory-based storage for jobs, library, and exports.
Integration with external processes (subprocess) and optional media tooling (ffmpeg) for export operations.
overview.summary: This module implements the core of a small desktop web app for managing music projects and exports. It sets up a simple HTTP server handler (H) to serve a web UI, provides utilities for timestamping and slug construction, and performs file-based data management under a configurable zi_data directory. The code supports scanning an audio library, importing folders, creating job records, reading and writing JSON job and library metadata, generating simple cover images, and exporting releases (optionally using external tools such as ffmpeg). A main entry point launches the server and opens the browser to the local UI.
